text_description: A runway look built around a black, textured, boxy long-sleeve jacket worn open over a matching black top and short fitted black bike shorts. The jacket has a collarless round neckline, a cropped-to-hip length, straight loose sleeves, and a structured, slightly oversized silhouette; small gold-tone buttons sit symmetrically on the front, including at the chest pocket area and lower front. Dense decorative appliqué and charm-like trim runs along the neckline, down both front edges, and at the cuffs, mixing red, white, yellow, and black floral or starfish-shaped crochet-like pieces with small metallic accents, creating a bright handmade contrast against the dark surface. Beneath it, the black underlayer extends slightly below the jacket with a softly flared hem edged in white piping, and matching white edging is visible at the sleeve cuffs. The lower half is minimal and close-cut, with high-thigh black cycling shorts leaving the legs bare. The model carries a vivid red openwork crochet handbag at one side, suspended from thin red handles or chain-like straps, echoing the red embellishments on the jacket. The overall styling contrasts a structured black embellished jacket with sporty abbreviated shorts and a handmade-textile accessory, producing a polished but playful luxury-craft mood.
